### 1. Architecture Overview
Receivers in the OpenTelemetry Collector are instantiated via the `receiver.Factory` interface (core repo). The core factory type in `receiver/receiver.go` defines a `CreateTracesFunc` signature and wiring: `receiver.NewFactory` receives `receiver.WithTraces(createFn, stability)` to register a `createTracesFunc`. When pipelines build, `Factory.CreateTraces` validates the ID and delegates to `createTracesFunc`, which is implemented per receiver factory (e.g., OTLP, Zipkin, AWS X-Ray, etc.). Each receiver’s factory `createTraces...` function is currently defined as `(context.Context, receiver.Settings, component.Config, consumer.Traces) (receiver.Traces, error)` and must be updated to accept an additional `logger *zap.Logger` parameter. Both the core factory definitions and every receiver factory (including contrib) must update signatures and call sites.

### 2. Detailed Analysis
- **Core type definition and dispatch**
  - `receiver/receiver.go` defines `CreateTracesFunc` and `factory.CreateTraces` which call the registered function with the current signature `(context.Context, Settings, component.Config, consumer.Traces)` (lines 106–155) and registers it via `WithTraces` (lines 181–187) [core repo, `receiver/receiver.go`].
  - Change required: update `CreateTracesFunc` to `func(context.Context, Settings, component.Config, *zap.Logger, consumer.Traces) (Traces, error)` and update the factory’s `CreateTraces` to pass the logger through. Update `WithTraces` to accept the new function type.

- **Core built-in receivers (must change createTraces signature and callers)**
  - `receiver/nopreceiver/nop_receiver.go`: `createTraces` currently `(context.Context, receiver.Settings, component.Config, consumer.Traces)` (lines 28–31) [core].
  - `receiver/receivertest/nop_receiver.go`: `createTraces` with same signature (line 44) [core test helper].
  - `receiver/otlpreceiver/factory.go`: `createTraces` registers the consumer (lines 69–89) with the legacy signature [core OTLP receiver].
  - `cmd/mdatagen/internal/samplereceiver/factory.go`: `createTraces` stub (line 27) [core sample receiver].
  - `cmd/mdatagen/internal/samplefactoryreceiver/factory.go`: `createTraces` stub (line 29) [core sample factory receiver].

- **Contrib receiver factories (each `createTraces*` must add logger and propagate)**
  - Examples (all use `receiver.WithTraces` and a `createTraces…` function with the old signature):
    - `receiver/awsxrayreceiver/factory.go`: `createTracesReceiver` (lines 42–49) [contrib].
    - `receiver/zipkinreceiver/factory.go`: `createTracesReceiver` (lines 44–52) [contrib].
    - `receiver/awss3receiver/factory.go`, `azureblobreceiver/factory.go`, `azureeventhubreceiver/factory.go`, `datadogreceiver/factory.go`, `githubreceiver/factory.go`, `gitlabreceiver/factory.go`, `googlecloudpubsubreceiver/factory.go`, `jaegerreceiver/factory.go`, `kafkareceiver/factory.go`, `libhoneyreceiver/factory.go`, `otelarrowreceiver/factory.go`, `pulsarreceiver/factory.go`, `receivercreator/factory.go`, `skywalkingreceiver/factory.go`, `solacereceiver/factory.go`, `zipkinreceiver/factory.go`, and others listed in the search results—all follow the same pattern and must update their `createTraces` signature, the `receiver.WithTraces` registration, and any tests that use function literals.

- **Factories using xreceiver (profiles-enabled)**
  - `receiver/nopreceiver/nop_receiver.go` and `receiver/receivertest/nop_receiver.go` use `xreceiver.WithTraces` with the same signature and must be updated accordingly; ensure `xreceiver` helper types also accept the new signature if they mirror `receiver.WithTraces`.

### 3. Relevant Files
| Repo | File Path | Why |
|------|-----------|-----|
| opentelemetry-collector | receiver/receiver.go | Defines `CreateTracesFunc`, `factory.CreateTraces`, and `WithTraces`; must add `logger *zap.Logger` to the signature and delegate it. |
| opentelemetry-collector | receiver/nopreceiver/nop_receiver.go | Built-in nop receiver factory; `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector | receiver/receivertest/nop_receiver.go | Test helper factory; `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector | receiver/otlpreceiver/factory.go | OTLP receiver factory; `createTraces` registration uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector | cmd/mdatagen/internal/samplereceiver/factory.go | Sample receiver; `createTraces` stub uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector | cmd/mdatagen/internal/samplefactoryreceiver/factory.go | Sample factory receiver; `createTraces` stub uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/awsxrayreceiver/factory.go | `createTracesReceiver` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/awss3receiver/factory.go | `createTraces` factory function uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/azureblobreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/azureeventhubreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/datadogreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/githubreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/gitlabreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/googlecloudpubsubreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/jaegerreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/kafkareceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/libhoneyreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/otelarrowreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/pulsarreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/receivercreator/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/skywalkingreceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/solacereceiver/factory.go | `createTraces` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/zipkinreceiver/factory.go | `createTracesReceiver` uses old signature. |
| opentelemetry-collector-contrib | receiver/otelarrowreceiver/factory_test.go, awsxrayreceiver/factory_test.go, etc. | Tests instantiate factories and use the old signature; must be updated to include logger argument. |

### Implementation Notes
1. **Core signature change**
   - Update `CreateTracesFunc` in `receiver/receiver.go` to include `logger *zap.Logger`.
   - Update `factory.CreateTraces` to accept the logger and pass it to `createTracesFunc`.
   - Update `WithTraces` to accept the new `CreateTracesFunc`.
2. **All receiver factories**
   - Update every `createTraces...` function signature to include `logger *zap.Logger` before `consumer.Traces`.
   - Update every `receiver.WithTraces(createTraces..., …)` call if the helper signature changes (it will, due to `CreateTracesFunc`).
   - Propagate logger to any downstream helpers if applicable (most factories currently ignore the extra argument; pass through or use as needed).
3. **Tests and helpers**
   - Update all test function literals and mocks (e.g., in `receiver/.../factory_test.go`, `receivertest/nop_receiver.go`) to add the logger parameter.
4. **xreceiver**
   - If `xreceiver.WithTraces` mirrors `receiver.WithTraces`, ensure its signature and any call sites (e.g., `nopreceiver`) are updated similarly.

By applying the above to all listed files in both the core and contrib repositories, all receiver factories will comply with the new signature `CreateTraces(ctx context.Context, set Settings, cfg component.Config, logger *zap.Logger, next consumer.Traces) (Traces, error)`.
